The same applies to Long-Term Residents (to be checked). Other statuses allow different kinds of work; check with Immigration (to be checked).

summary.en: If your status is Student or Dependent, get "permission to engage in an activity other than that permitted by the status of residence" before you start work (to be checked). The general permission is, in principle, up to 28 hours a week, and not at places running adult-entertainment businesses (to be checked). The permission is written on the back of your residence card. No fee (to be checked).
